mondaySteps.title: Turn up
mondaySteps.text: Find the crew at The Architect. Drop your bag, say hello, nobody minds if you are new.

mondaySteps.title: Run your way
mondaySteps.text: Pace groups for every runner. Go steady, go fast, or run and chat. It is a run and social, not a race.

mondaySteps.title: Stay for the social
mondaySteps.text: Back to The Architect afterwards. Cool down with a drink and the people you just ran with.

activities.name: Running
activities.note: Every Monday at 18:30, whatever your pace.

activities.name: Football
activities.note: Thursdays, 8pm to 9pm at Chester University Football Pitches.

activities.name: Netball
